newsitem.title: UK: Hampson makes agreed offer for Arabis.
newsitem.headline: Hampson makes agreed offer for Arabis.

text.p: Hampson Plc said on Wednesday that it has made an all-share recommended offer for Arabis, valuing the company at around 17.5 million pounds and 22.5p per share.
Hampson, an engineering and metals group, said in a statement that the offer was on the basis of 100 new Hampson shares for every 271 Arabis ordinary shares.

It said that it has received acceptances of 11.87 percent from Arabis management and that the acquisition would enhance earnings in the year to March 31, 1998. Arabis comprises four precision engineering businesses supplying the aerospace industry and a fifth company supplying specialised power steering products to the automotive and agricultural vehicle industries.
